*Sanidassanattika, Sappītikaduka* (Patthana 16.84) is a canonical Abhidhamma text situated within the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Methodologically, the work integrates the triad of visible phenomena (*sanidassanattika*) with the dyad of phenomena accompanied by zest or rapture (*sappītikaduka*), methodically examining their conditional relations according to standard Abhidhamma relational logic [SuttaCentral].
No separate ancient translations or curated parallels are registered for this section [SuttaCentral]. Its most extensive textual overlaps occur with other Paṭṭhāna divisions, especially *Sanidassanasappaṭighattika* (Patthana 1.23; 14 matches), *Sanidassanattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.27; 10 matches), *Sanidassanattika, Sappaṭighaduka* (Patthana 16.54; 5 matches), *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1; 8 matches), and closely aligned dyadic combinations within the same book such as *Sanidassanattika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.46) and *Sanidassanattika, Upekkhāsahagataduka* (Patthana 16.87) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus registers no cross-language matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan texts at or above the reporting threshold [DharmaNexus].
